A '''Queen of the Quesoth''' [[Species/Legends|species]] was the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. The [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] changed periodically, with each Queen dying when the next one rose. There were three Queens, the [[Queen of the Red]], the [[Queen of the White]], and the [[Queen of the Black]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
